ONE wide initial challenge scene in highland river terrain: exactly TWO adult brothers on dry land. Tomás in blue stands close to a modest flowing paper channel and extends an open empty hand toward the current; Pedro in brown, slightly farther along the dry path, turns to acknowledge the challenge before running ahead. Two separate full bodies, no duplication, physically grounded. River is ONE continuous broad pale/deep-blue paper ribbon between steep close folded banks. No dam, blocked water, sea yet, crown, apostle robe, cross, floating deity, staff, magic beam, labelled geography or invented prop.
